{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and remove QA rows (revenue == 999999.99)
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
df_loyal_completed = df_clean[(df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df_clean['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute the mean revenue
mean_revenue = df_loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Print the number of loyal, completed orders
print(f'Number of loyal, completed orders: {len(df_loyal_completed)}')

# Print the mean revenue
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers: {mean_revenue:.2f}')"}
